description: Named four-and-twenty against fourteen, and would pull the house down before paying to have the clause read.
name: James Burbage

description: Refused to call it a bargain, and sent you to be Navarre.
name: John Heminges

description: Put the timber ahead of the curse, and kept the king's purse off Navarre's.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked the length, and would not carry an unread clause into the yard.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Offered a long king, cursed nobody, and agreed nothing.
name: William Shakespeare
